instruction: Please enable Chrome to warn me if my passwords are exposed in a data breach.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling password breach detection in Chrome security settings. Custom getter get_chrome_password_breach_alerts__2107d226 checks Chrome Preferences for password_manager_leak_detection flag. Returns 'true' when password breach alerts are enabled.
metadata.verification: Custom getter verifies password_manager_leak_detection flag is true in Chrome Preferences profile section.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts password_manager_leak_detection flag from profile section
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares result string 'true' with expected value 'true'
Expected value 'true' is semantically correct for verifying password breach alerts are enabled
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the single requirement (enable password breach warnings)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is written and can be read
Practical feasibility: getter uses standard Chrome Preferences JSON file access patterns with correct OS-specific paths
No edge case issues: getter handles file read errors and JSON parsing correctly with try-except blocks
